title: agent-atlas Router (Model Policy) manifest
description: A model-routing policy: dynamically selects among candidate LLMs (e.g. Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI) by task complexity, output quality, latency, and cost. An agent references a Router instead of a single pinned model when its model choice is dynamic.

candidates.description: The models this router may select among. Held as data on the router (not separate objects).

pinned.description: exact pinned version of this candidate.

policy.description: How the router chooses. Rules are evaluated in order; fallback is used when none match.

rules.description: Ordered routing rules: when <condition> select <model name>.

select.description: candidate model name to route to.

fallback.description: candidate model name used when no rule matches.
